name: Xray (VLESS)
hint: Personal VLESS proxy over WebSocket and TLS on your app's address

CLIENT_ID.title: Client ID
CLIENT_ID.description: 32 hexadecimal characters; your client uses them as a UUID. The app prints the complete client link (vless://…) in its logs when it starts: copy it into v2rayN, v2rayNG, Hiddify, Streisand or any other VLESS client.

WS_PATH.title: WebSocket path
WS_PATH.description: Only connections to this path reach the proxy. BitTorrent, outgoing mail on port 25 and private network addresses are blocked.
